entities.summary: Cuthbert Collingwood "Ted" Tinling, sometimes known as Teddy Tinling, was an English fashion designer, spy, author, and tennis official. He was a firm fixture on the professional tennis tour for over 60 years and is considered the foremost designer of tennis dresses of the 20th century.
